site.name: vaultkey
site.summary: vaultkey-clone Fictional password manager "Vaultkey" — short marketing landing + main pricing page. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Short landing: hero with title / dual CTAs; faux app screenshot (categorized sidebar + searchable item list with passkey / family / 2FA tags); 7-name trust strip; 3 why-cards; bottom CTA | | `pricing.html` | Main page: yearly / monthly billing toggle (annual saves 20%); 3 plan cards (Personal $0 forever, Family $3.99/mo featured, Business per-seat); **Business per-seat slider 3–200 with linked number input**, 5-tier volume pricing (3–24 / 25–49 / 50–99 / 100–199 / 200+) with monthly + yearly totals; enterprise contact strip; 25-row grouped feature comparison table (5 groups: Vault & sync / Sharing / Security / Admin & compliance / Support); 8-question FAQ accordion | | `styles.css` | Brand color #1E1B4B indigo + #A3E635 lime accent; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 2 breakpoints (>1000 / <1000 / <640) |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of Vaultkey's landing (index.html) and pricing (pricing.html) pages, validating primary flows (pricing selection, plan comparison) and adjacent interactions (CTAs, responsive behavior).
run_plan.summary: Start with the landing page (index.html) to validate hero CTAs, trust strip, and why-cards. Then move to pricing.html to test billing toggle, plan cards, business seat slider/input, feature table, and FAQ. Repeat critical checks (e.g., slider, CTAs) in mobile viewport. Ensure all interactables (links, buttons, inputs) are exercised.
assumptions: The site has two main pages (index, pricing) with clear navigation; pricing has interactive elements (toggle, slider, inputs, accordions); responsive breakpoints exist at <1000px and <640px.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html:Business seat slider/input (3–200) for sync issues; small tap targets on navigation links; FAQ accordion accessibility.

phases.title: Landing Page (Desktop)
phases.objective: Validate hero section, trust strip, why-cards, and CTAs on index.html (desktop view).
key_checks: Click 'See plans →' (verify redirect to pricing.html); click 'Download free' (verify interaction feedback); check trust strip logos (Halcyon, Northwind, etc.) for visibility; validate why-cards (One shortcut, Real end-to-end, Shared with intent) for content and layout.
exit_criteria: All CTAs interacted; trust strip and why-cards validated; no console errors.

phases.title: Pricing Page (Desktop)
phases.objective: Test billing toggle, plan cards, business seat input/slider, and feature table on pricing.html (desktop view).
key_checks: Toggle 'Yearly'/'Monthly' (verify price updates); click 'Get Personal' (Family/ Business CTAs for feedback); interact with Business seat input (type 12, 25, 200+; verify volume pricing updates); check 3 plan cards for content consistency; open 2–3 feature table rows (Vault & sync, Sharing, Security) for visibility.
exit_criteria: Billing toggle works; seat input/slider validated; plan cards and feature table interacted; no console errors.

phases.title: Responsive Checks (Mobile Viewport)
phases.objective: Replicate critical checks (CTAs, pricing toggle, seat input) on mobile viewport (≤640px) to validate responsiveness.
key_checks: On index.html (mobile): tap 'See plans →' (redirect); tap 'Download free' (feedback); check navigation links (small tap targets) for interaction area. On pricing.html (mobile): toggle 'Yearly'/'Monthly'; interact with Business seat input (type 12); check plan card CTAs ('Start free 30-day trial', 'Start 14-day trial') for visibility.
exit_criteria: Critical CTAs and interactions work on mobile; responsive layout (breakpoints at <1000px, <640px) validated; no layout warnings escalated.

phases.title: FAQ and Accessibility (Desktop)
phases.objective: Validate FAQ accordion, enterprise CTA, and footer links on pricing.html (desktop view).
key_checks: Open 3–4 FAQ accordion items (Common questions) for content and interaction (expand/collapse); click 'Talk to sales →' (Enterprise CTA, verify feedback); check footer links (© 2026 Vaultkey, SOC 2, FIDO2) for visibility and interaction.
exit_criteria: FAQ accordion works; enterprise CTA interacted; footer links validated; no console errors.

phases.title: Final Validation (All Pages)
phases.objective: Recheck high-risk areas (business seat slider, small tap targets) and ensure all interactables are exercised.
key_checks: Re-verify business seat input (type 3, 24, 25, 49, 50, 99, 100, 199, 200+; check volume pricing); check navigation links (Vaultkey, Product, Pricing, etc.) for tap target consistency; verify FAQ accordion accessibility (keyboard navigation if applicable); check console for any new errors.
exit_criteria: High-risk areas validated; all interactables exercised; no console errors.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit both known pages (index.html, pricing.html) in both viewports (desktop, mobile).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls: 2 CTAs (index), 2 toggle buttons (pricing), 3 plan CTAs, 1 seat input/slider, 5 feature table rows, 3 FAQ accordions, and all navigation links.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (CTAs, toggle, seat input) on mobile viewport; validate responsive layout and tap targets.

notes: Focus on interaction feedback (e.g., button clicks, input changes) and layout consistency across viewports. Prioritize the business seat slider/input as a high-risk area for sync issues between slider and number input.

observation.title: Pricing — Vaultkey
observation.visible_text: Vaultkey Product Pricing Security Enterprise Help Sign in Get Vaultkey Pricing Plans for every kind of keychain. One credit card, unlimited devices, end-to-end encryption on every plan. Yearly · save 20% Monthly Personal For one human and their stuff. $ 0 / month Free forever for one device. Get Personal Unlimited passwords & passkeys 1 device Browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Arc) 2FA codes Basic password health report MOST PICKED Family Share with up to 6, never with the strangers. $ 3.99 / month Billed yearly · for the whole household Start free 30-day trial Everything in Personal Up to 6 family members Shared family vault & per-person private vaults Unlimited devices Encrypted file storage (5 GB / member) Emergency access for trusted contacts Dark-web monitoring on every email Business Per seat, with the audit log to prove it. $ 5.59 / seat / month Team size: 12 seats 3–24 seats · standard rate Per month $67.10 Per year $805.25 Start 14-day trial Everything in Family Per-team shared vaults & ACLs SSO (SAML, OIDC) on every plan Directory sync (SCIM) Admin console & audit log (12-month retention) SIEM webhook (Splunk / Datadog / Sumo) Encrypted file storage (50 GB / seat) Need bigger? Enterprise adds custom SSO, dedicated support, on-prem deployment, and a per-customer signed BAA. Volume discounts kick in at 250 seats. Talk to sales → Compare every feature. PERSONAL FAMILY BUSINESS VAULT & SYNC Unlimited passwords & passkeys ● ● ● Devices 1 Unlimited Unlimited Browser extensions ● ● ● Native apps (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android) ● ● ● CLI for shells & CI — ● ● Offline access ● ● ● SHARING Shared family vault (up to 6) — ● — Per-team shared vaults — — ● Per-item shares with expiry — ● ● Per-recipient access logs — — ● SECURITY End-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM) ● ● ● Hardware key support (YubiKey, Solo, etc.) ● ● ● Dark-web monitoring — All members All seats Password health report Basic Per-member Per-team rollup Encrypted file storage — 5 GB / member 50 GB / seat ADMIN & COMPLIANCE SSO (SAML, OIDC, Okta, Entra) — — ● Directory sync (SCIM) — — ● Per-policy controls (vault scope, geofence, session) — — ● Audit log retention — 90 days 12 months SIEM webhook (Splunk, Datadog, Sumo) — — ● SOC 2 / ISO 27001 reports — — ● SUPPORT Help center & community ● ● ● Email support — 48 h reply 12 h reply Priority + onboarding session — — ● Common questions. What happens if I forget my master key? ▼ Your master key never leaves your device — Vaultkey can't recover it. That's the point. We do offer optional recovery contacts (Family) and a printable, signed recovery kit (Business) so you can re-derive access without us holding any of the secret. observation.visible_text: Vaultkey Product Pricing Security Enterprise Help Sign in Get Vaultkey A password manager you'll actually use Every login, every passkey, one keychain. Vaultkey stores passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, and shared team secrets — encrypted end-to-end with a key only you can derive. Works on every browser, every device, every shell.
